## plan_packages

Order a directory of Zarf packages into a deployment plan.

Include it as `colonel_byte.zarf.plan_packages`.

Added in `colonel_byte.zarf` 0.90.0.

Inspects every package archive in a directory, extracts the `PackagePrerequisites` document the ones that carry it have, and sets `zarf_packages_to_deploy` to those packages in an order that satisfies what they declare.

The result is the input `colonel_byte.zarf.deploy_packages` consumes, so the two roles compose: this one decides what is deployed and in what order, and that one deploys it.

Packages declaring alternatives under one `requires.packages[].id` are resolved to a single candidate. A candidate already on the cluster wins, then one named in `zarf_plan_preferred`, then the highest `provides.priority`. A group none of the three settles is an error rather than a guess.

A package no plan reaches is left out rather than deployed, which is what keeps a losing candidate's own dependencies off the cluster.

The plan is the same for the same archives, the same cluster and the same preference list, whatever order the directory is read in.

A file in the directory that is not a Zarf package is reported and skipped. A cycle, an unsatisfiable version constraint, a requirement nothing provides and an unresolved group all fail the play before anything is deployed.

Every task carries `run_once: true` and delegates to `zarf_delegate_to`.

### Variables

| Variable                | Type            | Default                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------------- | --------------- | ---------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `zarf_plan_directory`   | `str`           | `""`                         | The directory holding the package archives to plan. Required: the role refuses an empty one.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `zarf_plan_patterns`    | `list` of `str` | `- "*.tar.zst"<br>- "*.tar"` | The filename patterns an archive is recognised by. Anything else in the directory - a checksum, a signature, a README - is ignored rather than inspected.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `zarf_plan_preferred`   | `list` of `str` | `[]`                         | Package names in preference order, used to settle a group of alternatives the cluster has not already settled. The first of them present among a group's candidates wins the group. It is where an operator states which provider this cluster should have, and it outranks the candidates' own `provides.priority`: every provider rates itself highly, and only the operator knows which one is wanted here. |
| `zarf_plan_use_cluster` | `bool`          | `true`                       | Whether to read the cluster's deployed packages before planning. A candidate already deployed wins its group, so a plan made with this off is the plan for a cluster with nothing on it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `zarf_kubeconfig`       | `str`           | `""`                         | Path to the kubeconfig file used to reach the cluster. Left empty, uses the default kubeconfig.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `zarf_public_key`       | `str`           | `""`                         | Path to the public key used to verify package signatures.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `zarf_verify`           | `str`           | `""`                         | When to verify package signatures. Left empty, zarf's own default applies. One of ``, `never`, `if-possible`, `always`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `zarf_binary`           | `str`           | `zarf`                       | Path to the `zarf` binary on the delegated host.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `zarf_delegate_to`      | `str`           | `localhost`                  | The node on which to execute the inspection tasks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
